shared_elements: mass of hair rendered as raised ridged/scalloped locks framing the head
low-relief facial features (brow ridge, eye, mouth)
justification: Both depict a heavily schematic anthropomorphic figure whose most distinctive feature is a helmet-like mass of hair rendered as thick raised rolls/scalloped locks arching over the brow and framing an otherwise nearly featureless, block-like face — an arbitrary and specific convention shared by both. The main difference in content is that A is presented as a head alone with frontal symmetrical face, bared teeth and closed eyes, while B shows the head attached to a coarse columnar body with shoulder/arm masses, seen so that the face reads in three-quarter/profile.
